leah-peopleops: Heads up 1  Quick Q on an off-cycle promo for Aisling (IE). Raj requested effective 2026-02-15 with retro. Can we include this in the next feed?

raj-eng-manager: Promotion SWE I -> SWE II, salary 45k -> 55k EUR, effective 2026-02-15. Manager evidence and org approval in the folder. Want pay in the upcoming run if possible.

maria-payroll: International partner feed cutoff is 2026-03-18 17:00 GMT. If submitted before that, base change can be included with that run. Otherwise itll be a manual retro adjustment next month (partner charges small admin fee). Note: taxes (PAYE/PRSI/USC) will be recalculated and YTD updates pushed by partner.

leah-peopleops: Does retro affect benefits enrollment dates?

maria-payroll: Benefits vendors generally accept retro enrolls if paperwork submitted within 30 days; sometimes manual vendor processing required. Finance will need to reconcile ledger entries after partner updates.

kevin-talentcomp: For equity: comp committee needs 3 business days to size grant on band change. Salary changes fine to go through earlier.

raj-eng-manager: Defer equity to next cycle. Priority is base salary retro.

leah-peopleops: Action list: 1) Raj paste single-line rationale here 2) Raj upload signed manager evidence + org signoff to retro form 3) Maria will create payroll ticket after form ID received 4) Kevin pings comp committee (info only).

raj-eng-manager: Rationale: "Promotion for consistent delivery of cross-service routing and mentorship of junior engineers." Uploaded form ID RETRO-2334, files at /hr/promos/aisling/.

maria-payroll: Got RETRO-2334. Creating ticket PAY-IE-2026-77 and will confirm admin fee + reconciliation ETA.

hr-bot: Retro form link: https://internal.forms/ie-retro-change. Use code IE-RETRO-2026.

leah-peopleops: Thanks all. I'll add a note to the employee file and will mark this thread closed once PAY-IE-2026-77 shows paid. Re-open if partner raises exceptions.
